input.content:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"
         xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
         xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 https://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
    <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>

    <parent>
        <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
        <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-parent</artifactId>
        <version>3.4.1</version>
        <relativePath/>
    </parent>

    <groupId>com.example</groupId>
    <artifactId>demo</artifactId>
    <version>0.0.1-SNAPSHOT</version>
    <name>demo</name>
    <description>Spring Boot project with testing support</description>

    <properties>
        <java.version>17</java.version>
    </properties>

    <dependencies>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter</artifactId>
        </dependency>

        <!-- Testing support:
             JUnit 5, Mockito (mocking), AssertJ/Hamcrest (assertions),
             Spring Test (context loading), JSONassert, XMLUnit -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-test</artifactId>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
    </dependencies>

    <build>
        <plugins>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
                <artifactId>spring-boot-maven-plugin</artifactId>
            </plugin>
        </plugins>
    </build>

</project>

part.text:
Done. Created a Maven Spring Boot 3.4.1 (Java 17) project:

- `pom.xml` — `spring-boot-starter` plus `spring-boot-starter-test` (test scope), which bundles JUnit 5, Mockito, AssertJ/Hamcrest, and Spring Test.
- `src/main/java/com/example/demo/DemoApplication.java` — `@SpringBootApplication` entry point.
- `src/test/java/com/example/demo/DemoApplicationTests.java` — `@SpringBootTest` context-loading smoke test.
- `src/main/resources/application.properties`, `.gitignore`.

The `spring-boot-starter-test` dependency covers all three requirements: mocking (Mockito), assertions (AssertJ + Hamcrest), and context loading (`@SpringBootTest`/Spring Test). Install Java 17 + Maven, then `mvn test` to run.
